scientific_integrity: Finite enumeration supplements a symbolic proof. The cited confluence concept and earlier strict-chain and modal-frame results are credited; no independence or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite reflexive chains and bi-total relations only; no exact asymptotic constant; finite checker is not an infinite proof. Closest related indexed records were accessible at title-and-summary level, so historical priority remains a risk.
title: Exact weighted census and edge spectrum of bi-total expansive chain correspondences
